title: Tunisian Egg Tagine
description: A traditional North African dish made with eggs, spices, and slow-cooked flavors.
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the crushed white and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground vibrant and slow, cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped cooked and tagine, cook for 2 minutes.
Crack in the eggs and scramble them into the mixture.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the eggs are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional chopped tagine if desired.
